01-37.solution: Adding the three pair rates counts each person twice: \(2(A + B + C) = \frac{1}{8} + \frac{1}{12} + \frac{1}{10} = \frac{15 + 10 + 12}{120} = \frac{37}{120}\). So \(A + B + C = \frac{37}{240}\) per day, and together they need \(\frac{240}{37} \approx 6.49\) days.
01-37.reason: Source option C printed 6.48, a truncation of 240/37 = 6.486; rounded to 6.49 so a student who rounds finds their answer. Key C unchanged, confirmed by blind pass.
